points: SELECT mein kya likha, **farak nahi** (1 chalega)

slides.title: Order wale [[customers]]
Ab [[trap]] wala data
slides.note: Ek order ka customer_id **NULL** hai. Ab dekho kya hota hai 👇

slides.title: NOT IN ne [[sab gayab]] kiya
slides.note: NULL se koi bhi comparison **UNKNOWN** deta hai, TRUE kabhi nahi

slides.title: Safe [[tareeka]]
slides.note: "Jinka nahi hai" wale sawaal mein hamesha **NOT EXISTS** 😎

slides.wrong:
WHERE id NOT IN (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders)
slides.right:
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM orders o
  WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)
slides.why: List mein ek bhi **NULL** → NOT IN **zero rows** deta hai, bina error ke

points: **EXISTS** = hai ya nahi, pehla match stop
